We have not surveyed for available rental units as the prospective displacees stated they do not want to rent.
The estimated relocation costs for this project would be $12,000.00.
CONCURRENT DISPLACEMENT
An investigation was made to determine the displacement activities of other agencies for any and all causes. The following data relates to these findings:
Current Projects - South 27th Street
There is no residential displacement left on this project. All of the residences have been relocated successfully. There is only one commercial displacee left to relocate.
- West Forest Home Avenue
All residential displacees have been successfully relocated. There are two commercial establishments remaining on this project.
- Airport Cargo Area
Six residential units are yet to relocate, some of which have replacement housing but are awaiting occupancy.
- Lapham Street
There are 8 individuals or families remaining on this project. It is anticipated that these people will not constitute a problem and the project is proceeding on schedule per the acquiring agency.
